text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After Mejiro Ardan gets injured during training, I rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Whew… It doesn't look like I'll need to go to the hospital. What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Even if I'd only ended up as an outpatient, my family might have insisted I recover as an inpatient.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: At any rate, let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: After all I've experienced, I've come to know my body and its limitations rather well. I needn't rest just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'm quite knowledgeable when it comes to rehabilitation. Shall we resume with a milder training regimen?
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself like this is too dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'm quite knowledgeable when it comes to rehabilitation. Shall we resume with a milder training regimen?
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself like this is too dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Dangerous… You make a valid point. I was very fortunate to avoid hospitalization, so I mustn't test my luck…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I apologize for allowing my emotions to get the better of me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall rest for today and focus on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A disappointed Mejiro Ardan trudges back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. Knowing that I'll have your help very much puts my mind at ease. I look forward to our continued efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: One… Two… Thr—ngh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm hardly putting any weight on it at all, but the pain…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Yes. …I ought to have taken my injury more seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please excuse me. It appears this injury needs tending to after all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A remorseful Mejiro Ardan returns to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Two more… One more… Phew…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That exercise serves to maintain muscle tone and flexibility. …I'm quite glad my body seems able to handle it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Right then, let's move on. And don't worry, I'll take care not to worsen my injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While monitoring her injury, Mejiro Ardan completes a light training session.
